intro: OWNER-ONLY TEST: MALL CALL, live percussion and experimental sound are among this fortnight's unusual Stockholm experiences.
disclaimer: OWNER-ONLY REHEARSAL — organizer dates and prices should be checked before booking. Some photo slots intentionally use text fallbacks and do not meet the production group-send standard.

top3.title: MALL CALL — an abandoned shopping mall becomes an electronic festival
top3.booking: 1- and 2-day tickets listed, subject to inventory
top3.description: Explore 30,000 square meters of empty shopping-mall corridors transformed into temporary dance floors, art and unexpected club spaces; acts include Röyksopp, Overmono and Mount Kimbie.

final_review.notes: Official organizer event information reviewed 15 November; ticket inventory not guaranteed.

top3.rationale: An abandoned mall turned into a new musical world—a rare exploration and electronic-music combination.
